description:
*ROTARY CLUB OF SKYCITY BORIVLI*
*SPIRITUAL, EDUCATIONAL & EMOTIONAL BONDING TOUR*
_Meet, Greet, Know Your Member & Family_

The real strength of any organisation lies in relations.

With this belief, our dynamic President *Rtn. Rajesh Sahu* and Team has taken a great initiative to organise a *3-Day Bonding Picnic Tour.*

*Dates: 30th October, 31st October & 1st November*
*Participants: 45 Members including Family*

*More than a picnic - It's about bonding hearts!*

The purpose of the tour is to Know Your Member, strengthen family-to-family bonding, and create an emotional connect for a stronger club.

A heartfelt special thanks to *Rtn. Praful Jobanputra*, who has taken all the pain and efforts to make this event successful. His dedication, planning and hard work behind the scenes is truly commendable.

*President's Thought:*
"Relations matter for any success in the organisation."

Let's come together to *Meet, Greet, Know and Bond as a Family.*

*An Initiative by President Rtn. Rajesh Sahu & Team*
*Event Coordinated with Great Efforts by Rtn. Praful Jobanputra*

_Rotary Club of Skycity Borivli - 2026-27
